facts.fact: Rokko is a mountain range, not a single viewpoint, overlookingOsakaBay inSetonaikaiNP.
facts.excerpt: The Rokko mountain range overlooks Osaka Bay in Setonaikai National Park.

facts.fact: MountRokkoCable and NunobikiRopeway are different routes; the latter reaches herb garden area rather thanRokkoGardenTerrace.
facts.excerpt: Alternatively, you can take the Nunobiki Ropeway
If you are coming from Arima Onsen, you can take the Rokko Arima Ropeway.

facts.fact: SanjoBus andRokko-MayaSkyShuttle serve differentmountain sights; current operation must be checked.
facts.excerpt: Visitors can use the Rokko Sanjo Bus and the Rokko-Maya Sky Shuttle Bus to move between major tourist spots across the mountains.

facts.fact: Nunobiki consists of four waterfalls nearShin-Kobe, not a guarantee all trails are easy or stepfree.
facts.excerpt: The Nunobiki Falls are a set of four waterfalls in the lush forested foothills of Mount Maya, a short walk from Shin-Kobe Station.

title: Japan Ministry of the Environment — national park in the city: Mount Rokko
